description: This Kotlin source file defines the SearchViewModel class used for managing search functionality within a notes application. It handles search queries, fetches notes and notebooks, and filters search results based on various note attributes.

classes.name: SearchViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class responsible for managing search logic and data flow for the notes application's search UI.

methods.name: getSearchResults
methods.description: Filters notes based on the search key and matches relevant note attributes and associated notebooks.

methods.name: setSearchQuery
methods.description: Updates the search query state, triggering the search flow.
